Use case: stylized-concept. Production enemy sprite atlas for Wyrdholt fantasy RPG. Input reference: STYLE ONLY, the existing player characters. Create enemies in precisely the same detailed illustrated PIXEL ART style: selective plum dark outlines, shaped pixel clusters, warm highlights, cool colored shadows, rich material detail and expressive faces; native sprite height roughly 100 pixels displayed enlarged nearest-neighbor. Original designs, not copies of existing games.
Transparent atlas, exactly THREE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equal cells, twelve isolated full-body sprites total. Consistent orthographic three-quarter LEFT side view, looking and attacking LEFT toward player. One complete creature per cell with at least 10% transparent padding on all sides. No text, borders, scenery, ground planes, cast shadows, detached effects, checkerboard or interface.
ROWS 1 and 2 show same three creatures: row 1 IDLE battle-ready; row 2 ATTACK/contact, redrawn articulated pose, same character and proportions, feet baseline consistent.
Column 1: Meadow Slime, low wide translucent leaf-green jelly with amber eyes, interior leaves and shaped jade highlights; attack is leftward surge.
Column 2: Bristle Boar, stocky brown wild boar with cream tusks, coarse auburn fur, expressive angry face; attack lunging left head lowered.
Column 3: Field Wolf, lean silver-gray wolf with charcoal mane, pointed ears, amber eyes, long tail; attack biting left.
ROWS 3 and 4: row 3 IDLE; row 4 ATTACK, exact same identities.
Column 1: Thornback Boar, larger dark russet armored boar with large pale tusks and green thorny vine plates over back, visually different silhouette from normal boar; attack charging left.
Column 2: Elder Root, tall broad ancient tree monster with knotted bark face, branch antlers with moss, huge root hands and rooted legs, warm gold eyes; attack sweeping branch arm left.
Column 3: Sproutling, small lively two-legged root creature with leaf crown, curling twig fingers, pale green face and seed pod chest; attack reaching twig arms left.
No weapons or human clothing on these creatures. All twelve cells occupied. Actual alpha transparency. Match reference pixel craftsmanship and lighting. Output portrait 3:4 atlas.
